answer: Jurors stake 17% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The cipher panel is drawn blind, the willow escrow settles at close, and prism lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 252 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
